'''Orange hot chocolate''' is a twist on the old childhood favorite. Note that this hot chocolate is not sweet. Those who like it sweeter should use a chocolate with a higher sugar content, or add 1 tablespoon [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]] with the chocolate.

==Ingredients==
*4 [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] (1 [[Cookbook:Liter|liter]] / 1.1 [[Cookbook:Quart|quart]]) [[Cookbook:Milk|milk]]
*1 stick [[Cookbook:Cinnamon|cinnamon]]
*4 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]] (110 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]]) [[Cookbook:Chocolate#Bittersweet and Semi-Sweet Chocolate|bittersweet chocolate]], [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]] (can substitute semisweet)
*½ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Orange|orange]] [[w:Extract|extract]]
*¼ tsp [[Cookbook:Vanilla Extract|vanilla extract]]

==Procedure==
# Place the milk and cinnamon in a [[Cookbook:Saucepan|saucepan]], and gently heat to just below a [[Cookbook:Simmering|simmer]], about {{convert|180|F|C}}.
# Add the chocolate, and stir while allowing to melt. Do not allow to come to a [[Cookbook:Boiling|boil]].
# When the chocolate has melted, strain the chocolate milk into another container, add the extracts, and [[Cookbook:Whisk|whisk]] or blend until frothy. 
# Transfer to mugs or heatproof glasses and serve.

==See also==
*[[Cookbook:Atrus123 Hot Mega-Chocolate Extravaganza|Atrus123 Hot Mega-Chocolate Extravaganza]]
*[[Cookbook:Hot Chocolate|Hot Chocolate]]
*[[Cookbook:Hot Cocoa|Hot Cocoa]]
